name: harbor-continue
description: One seamless take from four continue joins, 5 s shots: does the picture hold (colour, light, boat shape) and does the ambience run through without clicks?

shots.prompt: A small blue fishing boat returns to harbor at golden hour, gulls circling overhead, gentle waves, the low hum of the boat's engine, wide shot
The small blue fishing boat glides past the stone lighthouse at the harbor entrance, golden hour light, gulls calling, the engine humming, camera follows slowly
The small blue fishing boat slows beside a wooden dock, ripples spreading across calm water, warm golden light, gulls landing on the dock posts, the engine idling
The engine of the small blue fishing boat falls quiet, the boat rocks gently at the wooden dock, the sun touches the horizon, gulls settle, soft lapping water
